newsitem.title: UK: Nizhny Novgorod $100 mln bond likely late June-ING.
newsitem.headline: Nizhny Novgorod $100 mln bond likely late June-ING.

text.p: Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region is expected to launch a $100 million five-year Eurobond in late June or early July, a banker close to the deal said on Monday.

"Nizhny Novgorod region will likely issue a $100 million five-year Eurobond in late June, after Russia launches another bond," an emerging markets syndicate manager at lead manager ING Barings said. "Moscow will come first, then St Petersburg, then the Federation (of Russia) again and Nizhny Novgorod may well be launched in the latter part of June or perhaps early July," he said.
In February Standard & Poor's Corp assigned its BB minus long-term foreign currency rating to Nizhny Novgorod.
Moody's Investors Service assigned a Ba2 foreign-currency rating to the upcoming Eurobond.
